Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:
Digital Marketing Manager

Stellenbeschreibung:
Your Future at 3CON

The 3CON Group is an internationally successful hidden champion in plant engineering and special-purpose machinery. For many years, we have been developing high-end solutions for the automotive industry, the life sciences sector, and other demanding industries.

We are 3CON — bold pioneers, dependable problem-solvers, and a family-run global player. With over 800 employees worldwide across Austria, Germany, the USA, Mexico, and China, we shape industrial manufacturing at the highest level.

To strengthen our team, we are looking for a committed and creative individual to join us as a:

Digital Marketing Manager (m/f/d) — B2B / Pharma / Biopharma Industry

Your Responsibilities:

● Performance & Web: End-to-end management and optimization of LinkedIn Ads, Google Ads, and SEO (WordPress).

● Lead Pipeline: Structured qualification and handoff of marketing leads to our international sales team.

● Content: Creation of white papers, case studies, and web content tailored for B2B decision-makers.

● Budget & ROI: Ongoing monitoring and tracking of all campaign and event budgets.

Your Profile:

● Experience: At least 3–5 years of proven experience in B2B digital marketing—preferably within an industrial, technical, or life sciences background.

● Tech Stack: Demonstrated proficiency with LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Google Ads, GA4, WordPress, and CRM platforms.

● Mindset: Strong technical aptitude to translate complex concepts into high-impact content.

● Languages: Native or full professional fluency in English (primary working language) alongside strong business-level German.

● Project Management: Proven ability to manage budgets, meet complex deadlines, and execute international trade show projects seamlessly.

What We Offer:

● Challenging tasks in an international environment with flexible working-time models.

● State-of-the-art workplaces designed to the latest ergonomic standards.

● Individual development paths through a wide range of internal and external training opportunities.

● The opportunity for assignments abroad at our plants (Mexico, China, USA), including special bonuses.

● An in-house 3CON Health Center with a company doctor, sports offerings, and subsidized therapeutic massages (50% covered).

● An excellent company restaurant serving freshly prepared, regional dishes at preferential prices.

● A genuine team spirit fostered through regular sports, team-building, and social events.

● Exclusive employee benefits (including bike leasing and discounts with partner companies such as Hagebau and the Inntal Logistics Park).

Rewards That Pay Off:

● Compensation is based on the collective agreement for the metal industry. As we set high standards for top performance, we are expressly willing to pay significantly above this baseline — your actual salary will be agreed individually, based on your qualifications and professional experience.

Have we sparked your interest? Then we‘d love to get to know you.

We grew from $1M to $10M ARR in under 12 months and now serve 10,000+ customers.

Fonio is Europe's market leader for AI phone agents for SMBs. Now were expanding globally and into new products.

We move fast, take ownership, give direct feedback, and avoid politics and unnecessary meetings.

Join one of Europe's fastest-growing companies. 1 (Senior) IT Workplace Specialist (m/f/d) YOUR ROLE

You own fonio's internal IT setup end-to-end: every device, every account, every access right. From day one to the last day of every employee. We're scaling fast, and you build the backbone that keeps that scaling secure, automated, and audit-ready.

YOUR TASKS

 * Joiner, Mover, Leaver: Own the full employee lifecycle on the IT side. New hires get a ready-to-go laptop and all their accounts on day one. Role changes update access automatically. Leavers lose access the same day.

 * Device management: Set up, roll out, and manage all laptops via MDM (e.g. Jamf, Kandji, Intune). That includes enrollment, policies, encryption, updates, and inventory.

 * Access management & automation: Own SSO, user provisioning, and permissions across our SaaS stack (Google Workspace, Slack, Notion, and more), and automate as much of it as possible. Every manual step is a step too many.

 * SOC 2 readiness: Prepare fonio for SOC 2. Implement controls, document processes, and collect evidence, working closely with our external Information Security Officer. You don't need to be a security expert, but you make sure the groundwork is solid.

 * Internal IT support: Be the go-to person for everything tech inside fonio, from a broken laptop to a missing license.

 * Tooling: Keep our tool landscape clean. That means licenses, costs, vendor management, and getting rid of shadow IT.

WHAT TO EXPECT

 * Solo, end-to-end ownership of everything workplace IT.

 * Hands-on operational work combined with building systems that scale to hundreds of employees.

 * Close collaboration with People Ops, Engineering, and our external InfoSec lead.

 * Direct impact: every new colleague feels your work from day one.

WHAT YOU BRING

 * 2+ years of experience in IT administration, workplace IT, or IT operations, ideally at a startup or scale-up.

 * Hands-on experience with MDM solutions and managing macOS devices (Windows is a plus).

 * Solid knowledge of identity & access management (SSO, SCIM, Google Workspace admin).

 * Automation skills: scripting (Bash, Python, or similar) and/or workflow tools (Zapier, n8n, Make). AI-native working style.

 * Bonus: exposure to SOC 2, ISO 27001, or similar compliance frameworks.

 * Structured, pragmatic, low ego. You thrive in intensity.

 * Fluent English, German is a plus.

jobs.description:
Working with us means believing in the future; in the great people who are shaping it together every day and in the wide-ranging career paths it opens up. #believeinyourselfErste Group was founded in 1819 as the first Austrian savings bank and today it is one of the largest banking groups in Central and Eastern Europe (CEE). As an attractive employer, Erste Group offers interesting career opportunities in an international environment.

The department ICAAP, within the Enterprise-wide Risk Management (ERM) division, ensures group-wide risk portfolio steering based on a holistic, cross-risk oversight of risks. ICAAP supports the Erste Group's management with a robust enterprise-wide risk management framework to ensure that the bank group has the capacity to bear its acquired risks. The main focus areas of the unit are the Risk Materiality Assessment (RMA), Risk Bearing Capacity Calculation (RCC), Risk Appetite Statement (RAS), limit steering and defining the risk strategy. In addition, it covers CEE as well as entities in Austria. 1 Internship in Internal Capital Adequacy Assessment Process (all genders)  * Location:Wien

 * Working hours:Part-time

 * Occupational Area:Risikomanagement

 * Company:Erste Group Bank AG

Your Tasks

 * To support the team in in-depth analysis on selected cross risk issues, key focus: implementation of credit portfolio model in ICAAP

 * To conduct necessary analysis (via established tools and tools being under development) on key drivers of risk profile development

 * To coordinate the inputs from several entities and make necessary reconciliations

 * To actively participate in development of analytical ICAAP tools

 * To assist the team in preparing the presentations for the senior and top management as well as the regulators

 * To support management in day-to-day business

Your Background

 * Ongoing studies at University/University of Applied Sciences with a background in banking, economics, business administration, information technology, mathematics or statistics

 * Have basic knowledge about risk management and financial/banking products

 * Are willing to learn and have good analytical, administrative and communication skills

 * Are interested to work in an international and highly motivated team

 * Want to get a deeper understanding of Risk Management

 * Are flexible and able to work independently, but also act as a team player

 * Possess very good knowledge of Microsoft Office and / or have advanced IT knowledge (SQL, VBA...) incl. knowledge of Databricks (DBX), Python programming, and AI/Generative AI features across modern data and cloud platforms, with the ability to apply these technologies to data analytics, automation, and business use cases

 * Are fluent in German and English, knowledge of another CEE Language is an advantage

Our Offer

 * Exciting and challenging part-time internship (19.25h/week) as of January 2027 for 12 months

 * Support of your professional and personal development in a dynamic, comprehensive and interesting area

 * We guarantee an internship allowance of minimum EUR 2,745.32 gross per month on a full-time basis (except obligatory internships)

 * Discover and enjoy the https://www.erstegroup.com/en/career/benefits of Erste Group

 * We offer our employees the opportunity to divide their hours between working from home and at the office

 * We consider the diversity of our employees as key to innovation and success. As employer we are proud to offer everyone equal chances, irrespective of age, skin colour, religious belief, gender, sexual orientation or origin

Apply now:

The department is responsible for the model governance of credit risk models. The key responsibilities include the management and rollout of CRM specific policies and processes, the lead of projects and initiatives in the CRM area, the oversight and regular report of all CRM change the bank activities and the management of tasks and deliveries required by the regulation for the maintenance of Credit Risk Models. The model landscape department provides standards and services along the model lifecycle within CRM and to local entities as stipulated in the respective policies. The department maintain key expertise in the Asset Class and Default & Forbearance Policy and provides support / expertise on group-wide level. 2 Internship Model Landscape (all genders)  * Location:Wien

 * Working hours:Part-time

 * Company:Erste Group Bank AG

Your Tasks

 * Support Model Landscape Steering and Oversight (Model Inventory tool, update of yearly Model Tiering, maintenance of the model change stock-plan, Model Risk Management Report...)

 * Support of the model change initiatives (tracking, reporting on the progress and status)

 * Support in the preparation of regulatory (ECB) packages for requesting approval of model changes

 * Support on the further development of Model Governance policy framework

Your Background

 * Currently enrolled at a University/University of Applied Sciences with a business, financial or technical focus

 * Basic knowledge of relevant industry best-practices in the area of CR model development and/or Project Management

 * Basic knowledge of the Risk Management and other Bank Processes
